20261121-physics-g04-1.title: Mukuedza kwekuwana bharanzi
20261121-physics-g04-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Mukuedza kwekuwana bharanzi kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261121-physics-g04-1.material: Mukuedza kwekuwana bharanzi, zvizito zviviri zve10 g zvakasungirirwa panzvimbo nhatu kuruboshwe kwefulcrum. Zvizito zve10 g zvakawanda sei zvinodiwa panzvimbo imwe kurudyi kuti pave nebharanzi?
20261121-physics-g04-1.s.s1.prompt: Mukuedza kwekuwana bharanzi, zvizito zviviri zve10 g zvakasungirirwa panzvimbo nhatu kuruboshwe kwefulcrum. Zvizito zve10 g zvakawanda sei zvinodiwa panzvimbo imwe kurudyi kuti pave nebharanzi?

20261121-physics-g04-1.s.s1.hint.1: Kurudyi kureba kwenzvimbo imwe, saka huremu hunofanira kuva 60 g (zvizito zvitanhatu).

20261121-physics-g04-2.title: Chikonzero chesainzi chii

20261121-physics-g04-2.material: Kana uchibvisa msumari wakarohwa zvakasimba pabhodhi nesando yekubvisa nzara (claw hammer), kubata kumucheto wemubato kunoda simba duku kupfuura kubata pakati. Chikonzero chesainzi chii?

20261121-physics-g04-2.s.s1.explain: Mu lever, kureba kubva pafulcrum kuenda panzvimbo yesimba kana kuchiwedzera, simba duku rinogona kutamisa simba guru panzvimbo yekushanda (load), saka msumari unobviswa nyore.

20261121-physics-g04-2.s.s1.o.o1: Nokuti huremu hwemsumari hunova hwuchiri hwakareruka pakarepo
20261121-physics-g04-2.steps.0.prompt: Kana uchibvisa msumari wakarohwa zvakasimba pabhodhi nesando yekubvisa nzara (claw hammer), kubata kumucheto wemubato kunoda simba duku kupfuura kubata pakati. Chikonzero chesainzi chii?
20261121-physics-g04-2.steps.0.explain: Mu lever, kureba kubva pafulcrum kuenda panzvimbo yesimba kana kuchiwedzera, simba duku rinogona kutamisa simba guru panzvimbo yekushanda (load), saka msumari unobviswa nyore.

20261122-physics-g04-1.title: Kufunga kwepamusoro
20261122-physics-g04-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Kufunga kwepamusoro kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-physics-g04-1.material: [Kufunga kwepamusoro] Kana uchibudisa dombo rakakura nelever uchiisa fulcrum padyo nedombo (load), simba rekudzvanya rechanza rinoderera, asi kureba kunofanira kufamba nechanza kunoshanduka sei?
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.prompt: [Kufunga kwepamusoro] Kana uchibudisa dombo rakakura nelever uchiisa fulcrum padyo nedombo (load), simba rekudzvanya rechanza rinoderera, asi kureba kunofanira kufamba nechanza kunoshanduka sei?
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.explain: Kushandisa lever kunogona kuderedza huwandu hwesimba, asi kureba kunofanira kufamba nechanza kunowedzera sezvazvakaita, saka huwandu hwemushando wose hunochengetwa (work principle).
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.hint.0: Kana uchiwana mukana pasimba, unorasikirwa pakureba kwekufamba.
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.hint.1: Izvi zvinonzi 'musimboti wemushando (work principle)' mu physics.
20261122-physics-g04-1.s.s1.o.o3: Dombo rinosimuka rega pasina kufambisa chanza

20261122-physics-g04-2.title: Chii chinoita kuti kutamisa mutoro unorema
20261122-physics-g04-2.topic: Chii chinoita kuti kutamisa mutoro unorema
20261122-physics-g04-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Chii chinoita kuti kutamisa mutoro unorema kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-physics-g04-2.material: Chii chinoita kuti kutamisa mutoro unorema kunoda simba duku zvikuru paunenge wuchiiswa mugoridhe rine mavhiri kupfuura kuukweva pasi?
20261122-physics-g04-2.thinking.0: Chii chinoita kuti kutamisa mutoro unorema
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinoita kuti kutamisa mutoro unorema kunoda simba duku zvikuru paunenge wuchiiswa mugoridhe rine mavhiri kupfuura kuukweva pasi?
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.explain: Kana mavhiri akashandiswa, sliding friction pakati pepasi nechinhu inoshanduka kuita rolling friction diki zvikuru, saka simba re friction rinodzivirira kufamba rinoderera zvikuru.
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.hint.0: Fananidzai friction inoitika kana chinhu chichidhonzwa nenguva iyo mavhiri achitenderera.
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.o.o0: Nokuti mavhiri anoreva ('rolling friction') yepamusoro inova duku zvikuru kupfuura sliding friction
20261122-physics-g04-2.s.s1.o.o1: Nokuti mavhiri anoderedza huremu hwemutoro ku 1/10
